points: Study led by University of Exeter (UK) analysed UK Biobank and US All of Us data, covering ~1 million individuals.

points: US FDA accepted Merck's drug sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT) for priority review for advanced endometrial cancer.

About 68,000 US endometrial cancer cases expected in 2026, over 14,000 deaths - shows disease burden.
